title: sync: preserve original errors from --keep-going
body:
With --keep-going the individual copy errors were only logged, and run() returned a generic sentinel, so the exit code could no longer tell anything apart: even a sync where every failure was a missing image exited 1 instead of the documented 2.

The errors are now collected. When they are all image-not-found errors they are returned joined, so isNotFoundImageError still matches and the exit code is 2. For a mixed set of failures the generic sentinel is kept, formatting the individual errors with %s instead of %w so the joined tree can't be misclassified as "not found".
